reviews.text: LOOK AT THE PHOTOS. If you have eyes then you’ll see a million different reasons to hire Justin. Since meeting Justin just a few weeks ago, he has been my go-to. He mounts everything with ease, assembles anything in his sleep and he makes sure you’re content before he leaves. Moreover, he finds other things he can do if he still has a little time left. He’s truly been the best part of my remodeling process. He makes all my projects a million times easier!  You won’t be disappointed!
reviews.author: Omoye Usen

reviews.text: Justin is absolutely fabulous! He is incredibly professional, responsive, and helpful. Justin assisted me in hanging quite a few pieces of art work on my walls and mounted a clothing rod. He was knowledgeable, precise, and ensured I was completely happy before leaving the job. I cannot recommend Justin enough!
reviews.author: Amy Paret

reviews.text: Justin did an excellent job installing a new ceiling light fixture.  He was courteous, cleaned up any mess & took the old fixture outside for trash.  I will definitely use him again & have already recommended him to family.
reviews.author: Desiree Ellis

reviews.text: Justin is wonderful and takes professional to an whole another level! When I say he knocked this sectional couch out in the snap of an finger it was amazing & he even cleaned up as he worked! Will continue to his services from here on out!
reviews.author: Michael Dabney

reviews.text: Called early in the morning and set up an appointment for this afternoon at 2pm. The guy never even showed up. I called and left a voice message. It’s all good. I highly dislike when people waste people’s time especially if you’re a business. Must be professional always even if you’re not gonna show up you have to let the customer know ahead of time.  People have things to do.
reviews.author: Tanisha Jean
